Read whole_row.py. The dialects the product supports (sqlite, postgres, mysql: safety/readonly.py:122-124, relations.py) all reserve TABLE, so an unquoted TABLE cannot be a column or table name there. I did not run sqlglot; the parse-tree reasoning is from the code. The docstring claim is therefore consistent with the code for the supported dialects. A dialect that allows unquoted `table` (ClickHouse) is not wired in the source.
